title: docs(skill): teach the `metadata` doc embed in objectstack-ui (ADR-0051)
body:
The ADR-0051 ` ```metadata ` doc-embed feature shipped (P1 fully merged), but the **AI-authoring skill never learned about it** — an author guided by `objectstack-ui` wouldn't know the capability exists. Worse, its "Docs — Package Documentation" section actively said the opposite:

> ~~Don't try to embed a live component … there is no inline SDUI.~~

This updates `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`:

- **Rewrites that callout** into the correct distinction: link *live instances* (dashboards, reports, record tables) by URL; embed *structural views* (state machine / flow / permission) inline.
- **Adds an "Inline metadata views" subsection** teaching the ` ```metadata ` fence: the three `type`s, required vs optional fields (table), the `os build` lint (body shape + same-package reference liveness, did-you-mean), and the **`permission` P3 caveat** (matrix not yet projected to the reader — keep it out of docs reachable by less-privileged/anonymous readers until P3).

### Notes

- The auto-generated `references/_index.md` already point at `ui/component.zod.ts`, so `element:metadata_viewer` is version-aligned automatically — no reference regeneration needed.
- Body-only change; `skills/README.md` + `content/docs/guides/skills.mdx` stay in sync (`check:skill-docs` passes locally).

Completes the "build it / teach it" loop for ADR-0051.
